name: F5-TTS
tagline: Zero-shot voice cloning and text-to-speech running locally offline
real_test_summary: Cloned a 10-second reference voice and synthesized a 20-second narration in 3.4s on an RTX 3060 12GB.
pros: Accurate zero-shot voice cloning from short samples
cons: Needs at least 4GB VRAM for smooth speed
Reference audio must be clean without background noise
description: Flow-matching text-to-speech system capable of cloning any voice from a 10-second reference WAV clip completely offline without cloud uploads.
